About our brand and products:

American Maid is a family-owned home cleaning brand built on faith, tradition, and independence. We make non-toxic, plant-based cleaning essentials that actually work — all 100% made in the USA. Our hero product, the Starter Kit, includes a powerful concentrate that replaces nearly every cleaner in your home, helping homemakers simplify, save, and support American jobs.

What makes us different:

We’re not another greenwashing brand. Our products are made by real American families, not corporations. Every bottle, label, and formula is sourced and produced right here in the USA — with no toxins, no shortcuts, and no outsourced manufacturing. We exist to help families reclaim their homes, health, and heritage from big-brand chemicals.

How affiliates can earn:

  • Earn 10–20% commission on every sale through your custom link or code

  • Monthly bonuses for top performers

  • Free products or deep discounts for brand ambassadors

  • High-converting product pages, beautiful imagery, and authentic storytelling that does the selling for you

How to promote us:

Share your love for homemaking, non-toxic living, and American-made products with your community. Post honest reviews, cleaning demos, or lifestyle content showing our products in real homes. You can share affiliate links on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, blogs, or email newsletters — wherever your people are.

Other information:

We welcome moms, homemakers, content creators, and small businesses who care about family, faith, and freedom. Whether you’re just starting or have an established audience, we’ll support you with creative assets, community, and fair rewards.

Website: americanmaidco.com
Instagram: @americanmaidco
Contact: hello@americanmaid.company

American Maid Affiliate Program: Terms & Conditions

Last Updated: 09/20/2024

By joining the American Maid Affiliate Program, you agree to abide by the following terms and conditions. Please review them carefully. Participation in the program indicates your acceptance of these terms.

1. Enrollment in the Program
To enroll in the American Maid Affiliate Program, you must submit an application. Acceptance into the program is at our sole discretion, and we reserve the right to reject any application for any reason.

2. Commissions
As an affiliate, you will earn commissions on qualifying sales made through your unique affiliate link. The commission rate is subject to change at any time without prior notice. You will be notified of any changes to commission rates by email or through your affiliate dashboard.

3. Payment of Commissions
Commissions will be paid out on a monthly basis, once your earnings meet or exceed the minimum payout threshold of [$100]. Payments will be made via PayPal or bank transfer, etc.. You are responsible for ensuring your payment details are accurate and up to date. Any payment discrepancies should be reported within 30 days.

4. Affiliate Responsibilities
As an affiliate, you agree to promote American Maid products in a lawful, honest, and ethical manner. This includes:
- Not using false or misleading claims in your promotions.
- Not engaging in spamming, fraudulent traffic generation, or other deceptive practices.
- Complying with FTC guidelines, including proper disclosure of affiliate relationships.
  
Failure to comply may result in termination from the program and forfeiture of any unpaid commissions.

5. Content Usage Rights
By participating in the American Maid Affiliate Program, you grant American Maid the perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free right to use, reproduce, modify, and distribute any content you create or share in connection with the program. This includes, but is not limited to, social media posts, images, videos, and written content, for marketing, promotional, or any other business purposes.

6. Termination
Either party may terminate this agreement at any time, with or without cause. If you wish to terminate, you can do so by [contacting us via email or other methods provided]. American Maid reserves the right to terminate your affiliate status immediately if you violate any of the terms set forth in this agreement.

Upon termination, you will no longer have access to your affiliate dashboard, and any unpaid commissions may be forfeited at our discretion, depending on the circumstances surrounding the termination.

7. Changes to the Program
American Maid reserves the right to modify or discontinue the Affiliate Program at any time without prior notice. This includes changes to commission rates, payment schedules, or program terms. Any changes will be communicated via email or through your affiliate dashboard.

8. Relationship of Parties
You are participating in the Affiliate Program as an independent contractor. This agreement does not create any partnership, joint venture, employment, or agency relationship between you and American Maid.

9. Limitations of Liability
American Maid is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your participation in the affiliate program. This includes loss of revenue, profits, or data, even if we have been advised of the possibility of such damages.
